texto: Formative test of the contents worked in A1. It includes a reading understanding of each enlargement chapter; the score guides the review and does not itself certify the CECRL level.
Each question indicates its chapter so that you can return to the corresponding explanation.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 1. Say your name
bloques.frase: Je ___ Léa.

opciones.explicacion: My name is Je m-appelle.
He's going with «tu».
He's going with «vous».

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 1. You talk to an older man you don't know. What do you use?

opciones.explicacion: With unknown adults, «vous».
It's for friends and family.
It's the emphatic form of «tu».

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 2. Denial
bloques.frase: Elle ___ pas française.

opciones.explicacion: Elle n-est pas.
The verb is missing.
«ne» is missing.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 2. Which one's right?

opciones.explicacion: The profession goes without an article.
«un» foam.
For professions the verb «être», not «avoir», is used.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 3. What do you mean, «I'm 30.»?

opciones.explicacion: Avoir + number + ans.
Age goes with «avoir».
«ans» is missing.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 3. Posessive
bloques.frase: C'est Paul et ___ sœur.

opciones.explicacion: «Sœur» is feminine → sa.
It's for masculine.
It's for plural.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 4. «il y a» denial
bloques.frase: Il n'y a pas ___ jardin.

opciones.explicacion: Pas de + nombre.
After «pas» goes «de».
After «pas» denial, the indefinite or partitive articles are transformed into «de».

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 4. Which one's right?

opciones.explicacion: From + le = du.
It melts into «du».
«de» is missing.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 5. Reflective verb
bloques.frase: Je ___ lève à sept heures.

opciones.explicacion: Je lève me.
He's going with «tu».
It goes with him or her.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 5. What do you mean, «I never work.»?

opciones.explicacion: Ne-jamais.
«Jamais» replaces «pas».
«Ne» should be placed before the conjugated verb.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 5. What time is «huit heures et demie»

opciones.explicacion: Et demie = half.
It would be «et quart».
It would be «sept heures et demie».

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 6. Specific
bloques.frase: Je prends ___ pain.

opciones.explicacion: «Pain» is masculine → du.
It's for feminine.
It would be a concrete bread.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 6. Which one's right?

opciones.explicacion: Quantity + of.
After «beaucoup» goes «de».
«de» is missing.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 7. Demonstrative
bloques.frase: J'aime bien ___ robe.

opciones.explicacion: «Robe» is feminine.
It's for masculine.
It's for plural.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 7. Compare
bloques.frase: Ce sac est plus cher ___ cette veste.

opciones.explicacion: Plus that.
The comparison of superiority is built with «plus ... que», not «de».
In the French superiority comparisons «que» is used.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 8. What do you mean, «turn left»?

opciones.explicacion: Imperative.
That's right.
That's «siga recto».

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 8. Transport
bloques.frase: Je vais au travail ___ bus.

opciones.explicacion: By bus.
«À» is for see and stand.
The «en» preposition is used for means of transport in which you travel inside.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 8. What do you mean, «I know how to swim»?

opciones.explicacion: Skill → savoir.
No preposition.
The skills are expressed with the verb «savoir» followed by infinitive, not with «être».

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 9. Aimer + infinitive
bloques.frase: J'aime ___ au tennis.

opciones.explicacion: Aimer + infinitive.
It takes the infinitive.
That's the participle.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 9. Which one's right?

opciones.explicacion: With months goes «en».
The «en» preposition is used during the months of the year.
The months of the year go with «en», not «à».

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 9. Next future
bloques.frase: Demain, je ___ voir mes parents.

opciones.explicacion: Je vais + infinitive.
The near future is formed with the present of the verb «aller», not with «être».
«Avoir» is used for the composite passé, not for the near future.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 10. I passed composé
bloques.frase: Hier, j'___ mangé au restaurant.

opciones.explicacion: J-ai-mangé.
«Manger» goes with «avoir».
It goes with him or her.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 10. Which one's right?

opciones.explicacion: «Aller» goes with «être».
It's not «avoir».
You need the participle.

bloques.pregunta: Listen. What does that mean?
bloques.audio: Hier, je suis allé à Lyon et j'ai visité un musée.

opciones.texto: I went to Lyon yesterday and visited a museum.
opciones.explicacion: Two passes: one with «être» and one with «avoir».

opciones.texto: I'm going to Lyon tomorrow to visit a museum.
opciones.explicacion: It's past.

opciones.texto: I went to Lyon yesterday and I saw a movie.
opciones.explicacion: «Musée» is a museum.

bloques.pregunta: Order the words.
bloques.frase: Je vais voir ma famille la semaine prochaine
bloques.traduccion: I'm going to see my family next week.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 5. What do you mean, «I'm reading right now.»?

opciones.texto: Je suis en train de lire.
opciones.explicacion: In train + infinitive expresses an ongoing action.
It means «I'll read».
Demain's tomorrow, not right now.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 5. The proposed time is good. What do you say?

opciones.explicacion: It means «I'm good at it.».
It means «I have to cancel.».
It means «I'm late.».

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 9. What do you say to congratulate someone on their birthday?

opciones.explicacion: It's a birthday greeting.
It means «Good luck.».
It's used to congratulate on good news.

bloques.pregunta: Cap. 10. What does «Je viens de finir» mean?

opciones.explicacion: Come in present + of + infinitive express recent past.
It would be «je vais finir».
He doesn't express a habit.
